infrastructure.name: Dockerfile
infrastructure.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the REGOS integrations gateway: a Node 20 stage compiles the TSD PWA client assets, then a Python 3.12-slim stage installs dependencies, copies the app plus built assets, sets the Asia/Tashkent timezone, and launches the FastAPI app via uvicorn on port 80.

infrastructure.name: client-builder
infrastructure.summary: Node 20-alpine build stage that runs npm ci and npm run build to compile the TSD PWA frontend assets under clients/tsd/pwa.

infrastructure.name: python
infrastructure.summary: Final python:3.12-slim runtime stage that installs Python requirements, copies the application and the prebuilt PWA assets, configures the Asia/Tashkent timezone, and runs the FastAPI server via uvicorn on port 80.

data.name: igc_business_map
data.summary: MySQL/InnoDB migration creating the igc_business_map table that persistently maps Instagram Business Account IDs to their connected REGOS integration, with active-status flag and audit timestamps. Transient queues, retries, dedupe, and route caches are kept in Redis rather than this table.

data.name: mlg_page_map
data.summary: MySQL/InnoDB migration creating the mlg_page_map table that persistently maps a Meta (Facebook) page_id to its connected REGOS integration, with page name, active flag, and audit timestamps; transient lead-gen state stays in Redis.
